timeline_reviews.summary: Serial CLI stream contained transport events only; the semantic solution path is in the single raw agent trajectory.
Serial parent performed all implementation, packaging, integration, and verification locally with no workflow or subagent delegation.

parallel.requirements: The parallel parent identified the full jusText implementation task: package modules, 100 stoplists, setup/config/docs, API exports, and evaluator-aligned tests.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: The parent owned construction and used a separate workflow only for adversarial verification across equivalence, spec audit, hidden-test prediction, and review domains.
parallel.implementation: It copied upstream/reference code, applied reference deltas for lxml cleaner, thresholds, and tags, added define_stoplist handling, __init__ exports, stoplist filesystem fallback, packaging files, conftest, and integration tests.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: The final workspace contained the package tree, docs, web demo, setup files, tests, and stoplists; no child-owned code was merged into the deliverable.
parallel.verification: Local pytest runs passed, several workflow children found only minor or environmental issues, and official evaluation passed 61/61; the workflow aggregate itself was killed before result.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The main unfinished process artifact was the adversarial verifier workflow and its aggregate reduction; a bare import from / still hit broken site-packages in one parent check, but official grading used the workspace successfully.

serial.requirements: The serial actor recognized the same complete jusText clone requirements and the need to reconcile prompt examples with the reference oracle and upstream tests.
serial.plan_and_ownership: A single actor performed discovery, implementation, packaging, testing, environment repair, docs updates, and final cleanup without subagents or workflow handoffs.
serial.implementation: It copied upstream sources and stoplists, patched the reference deltas, expanded exports, fixed define_stoplist for unhashable iterables, added packaging/config files, docs corrections, integration and CLI tests.
serial.integration_and_delivery: It built and installed the wheel to repair neutral-cwd imports, removed build/cache artifacts, and left a complete final tree with source, tests, docs, stoplists, and web demo files.
serial.verification: It ran official upstream tests, integration tests, CLI checks, wheel/package checks, coverage, and official evaluation; the completed official record passed 61/61.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The process timed out at the runner level after a complete local solution path, but no unjoined child result or missing deliverable remained in the serial trajectory.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Recognized the required jusText clone, stoplists, packaging, public API exports, tests, docs, and reference-compatible deltas.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Recognized the same requirements and used the installed/PyPI/GitHub sources as an oracle for the same project surface.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No material requirement difference explains the score: both tracked the same package and official tests passed. Parallel additionally framed a broad verifier workflow after implementation.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parent owned implementation and delivery, then delegated many independent read-only verifier tasks to workflow children.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: One actor kept implementation, packaging, testing, and cleanup in a single local sequence with no delegation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel split verification across children while serial stayed single-threaded; implementation ownership was not missing in either run.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Verifier prompts supplied the oracle path, import rules, read-only workspace rule, structured findings schema, and domain-specific scopes.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial actor kept context locally and corrected path-shadowing and spec/reference contradictions without cross-agent handoffs.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No missing brief or interface contract explains behavior; the parallel handoff context was detailed, but its aggregate result did not return before closure.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Copied upstream jusText, added stoplists, applied reference deltas, expanded exports, added utils fallback, conftest, setup files, and integration tests.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Copied the same upstream sources, applied the same reference deltas, added define_stoplist handling, packaging, docs updates, CLI tests, and cleanup.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The delivered code paths were functionally equivalent for official grading. Serial also force-reinstalled the built wheel for neutral-cwd imports; parallel noted that hazard but did not complete that repair before timeout.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parent launched a verifier workflow whose all-results verify stage depended on prior child returns; the workflow ended killed with null result.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: There were no child results to retrieve; the serial actor directly observed local test, package, wheel, and cleanup results.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel lost the complete workflow verifier lifecycle, while serial consumed its local command results inline.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parent controlled /workspace writes; child agents were instructed to stay read-only there and use /tmp for scratch work.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Single actor integrated directly in /workspace, installed the wheel over the broken site-packages copy, then cleaned build/cache artifacts.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No concurrent write collision is proven. Serial had less shared-state coordination risk because no live child wrote or consumed workspace artifacts.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Local tests passed and the official evaluator passed, but the large adversarial verification workflow never produced its final aggregate.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial passed local upstream/integration/CLI/coverage checks and then passed the official evaluator.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both had sufficient official acceptance evidence, but serial completed its self-directed verification loop while parallel left the optional workflow-level adversarial loop incomplete.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The verifier workflow fanned out to 19 agents with repeated stall retries, 1.69M tokens, 618 tool calls, and was killed before returning a result.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial also hit process timeout but without child fan-out; it had already cleaned the final tree and official evaluation passed.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The concrete coordination cost is parallel-only: broad verifier fan-out consumed the remaining closure window and prevented the workflow aggregate from being consumed.

outcome_analysis.explanation: There is no discordant official outcome to explain: both completed official evaluation and passed 61 of 61 tests. The main task-solving difference is process structure. Parallel built a working project and then spent the remaining window on a broad, retrying verifier workflow whose aggregate never returned; serial kept verification local, additionally repaired neutral-cwd import behavior by reinstalling the wheel, cleaned the tree, and also passed official evaluation.
parallel_contributors: Parent implementation covered the required jusText files, stoplists, packaging, and tests before official evaluation.
The broad verifier workflow created adverse process cost but did not change the official pass outcome.
serial_contributors: Single-actor sequence completed implementation, local verification, wheel install, cleanup, and official pass without delegation lifecycle risk.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Serial force-reinstalled the built wheel to repair neutral-cwd imports; parallel observed the same bare-import hazard but did not complete that environmental repair before timeout.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; retained label describes a parallel-side adverse process consequence only

The parallel parent created a multi-phase verification workflow with many equivalence, spec audit, predicted-test, and review agents, then required an aggregate verify stage over all child outputs. The workflow state records 19 agents, repeated stall retries, 1.69M tokens, 618 tool calls, killed status, null result, and several children still in progress/start before the parent process ended. This shortened and trapped the parent-chosen verification stage, although the already-delivered project still passed official evaluation.
candidates.realized_consequence: The parallel run closed without the verifier workflow aggregate, with multiple child checks interrupted or still active, so the parent never consumed a complete adversarial verification result before process termination.
candidates.near_match_reason: The missing aggregate verifier return is the terminal symptom of the same broad retrying fan-out; taxonomy precedence assigns this episode to Fan-out Budget Exhaustion rather than a separate result-timing label.
